Gaslighting monitors

An attacker model secretly argues for a wrong answer. Graders from the attacker's own family and from other families (GLM, Kimi, Qwen, GPT) judge it with a neutral prompt. Each tab is one attacker; the hidden CoT is shown in gray.

math3: 100 free-response math problems (60 omitted-case, 40 other planted errors). trivia3: 100 open-ended trivia questions. 2 models (GPT-6-sol, Gemini-4-Argon) each attack and grade every item, in the neutral, self-check and skim (1k thinking cap) frames. Text is trimmed to fit: grader replies show only their last 250 characters, and grader CoT is omitted.
